profile_text.body:
Rytr is an AI writing assistant available at rytr.me that the company describes as a free tool for generating high-quality content faster. The service is positioned as accessible to users at no initial cost, with the option to upgrade as usage grows.

The site's held facts list Rytr's primary product under the Writing and Editing category, with a focus on marketing copy. User testimonials on the site describe satisfaction with the tool's speed and accuracy, and note that outputs have been mistaken for human-written content, though these reflect promotional material rather than independently verified claims. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded for Rytr in the held facts.
